business_problem: L'Oréal needed a reliable global streaming backbone that could replace Azure Event Hubs limitations, connect operational and analytical systems in real time, and reduce the maintenance burden of hundreds of API, file-transfer, and ETL integrations.
solution_summary: L'Oréal standardized on Confluent Cloud as the global event backbone for its modernization program after Azure Event Hubs exposed scaling, filtering, and operational limits. The platform is used to move product and business events between operational systems, analytical systems, and third-party listeners in real time so internal teams and partners can act on current inventory and production changes. Instead of maintaining hundreds of API calls, managed file transfers, and ETL jobs, the team is collapsing those exchanges into event streams that are easier to scale and govern. Confluent also supports sensitive internal use cases by running private-cloud clusters for PII-heavy workloads, while the broader rollout is migrating roughly 200 applications onto the new streaming architecture in phases.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Acts as L'Oréal's managed global streaming backbone for real-time data exchange across internal and partner systems.

data_flow: Operational and analytical systems publish events into Confluent Cloud, which then distributes real-time product and business updates to internal applications and third-party listeners such as retail partners instead of routing those exchanges through APIs, file transfers, and ETL.
business_outcome: L'Oréal improved performance and agility by replacing hundreds of brittle integrations with event streams, giving partners faster access to product data and establishing a scalable foundation for additional internal and external data-driven services.
architecture_clues: L'Oréal uses private-cloud Confluent clusters for sensitive internal use cases that include PII.
The modernization program is migrating around 200 applications from Azure Event Hubs in phases.
Third-party applications consume manufacturing and inventory events directly from the streaming platform.
evidence_quotes: "To have data streaming implemented at a global scale at L'Oréal called for a platform that's reliable, can auto-scale depending on our need...and can cater to our future growth."
"With Confluent, L'Oréal has been able to streamline this process by replacing hundreds of API calls, managed file transfers, and ETL with a few efficient events."
"The company has numerous third party applications, including Sephora, Monoprix, and Carrefour, that aren't hosted on L'Oréal but are active listeners of products that get manufactured at L'Oréal."
"We cannot build such use cases on a public cloud because that (PII) data is really sensitive. With Confluent we have our clusters on a private cloud."
